# Load and inspect data from X to 2008
```{r}
#add block purpose and ECHO parameters to each chunk

library(data.table)
library(dplyr) #data format manipulation
library(janitor)
library(lubridate)
library(ncdf4) #read nc files (3 and 4 type)
library(purrr) #avoiding loops to extract data from vectors and then build abiotic/ nutrients tables
library(readr) #write out or read in tables
library(stringr) #similar to purrr, really great for name/ characteristic changes
library(tibble) #creating tables
library(tidyr)



file_path <- "../data/raw/nccos_chem_data.txt"


# Import all fields as character to preserve values
noaa_raw <- fread(
  file_path,
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  colClasses = "character",
  na.strings = NULL,
  data.table = FALSE
) |>
  janitor::remove_empty("cols") |>
  janitor::clean_names()

# Inspect structure
dim(noaa_raw)
names(noaa_raw)
glimpse(noaa_raw)

```

```{r}

# Audit matrices before filtering
noaa_raw |>
  count(matrix, scientific_name, sort = TRUE)

# Check actual temporal coverage
noaa_raw |>
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(fiscal_year),
    collection_date_parsed = mdy_hms(
      collection_date,
      quiet = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  summarise(
    first_year = min(year, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_year = max(year, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_collection = min(
      collection_date_parsed,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    last_collection = max(
      collection_date_parsed,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )

# Inventory qualifier types
noaa_raw |>
  count(qualifier, sort = TRUE)

# Inventory units across sample matrices
noaa_raw |>
  count(matrix, unit, sort = TRUE)

# Inventory analytical methods
noaa_raw |>
  count(method, sort = TRUE)

write_csv(noaa_raw, "../data/raw/noaa_raw1986-2012.csv")
#glimpse(XX)

```


# Create a standardized dataset 
```{r}

# Create shared working directory if necessary
working_dir <- "../data/_cleaned"


# Standardize all NOAA chemistry records
noaa_clean <- noaa_raw |>
  transmute(
    source = "NOAA_NCCOS_NST",
    study,
    site_id = nst_site,
    site_name = general_location,
    specific_location,
    sample_id,
    latitude = parse_double(latitude),
    longitude = parse_double(longitude),
    fiscal_year = as.integer(fiscal_year),
    collection_date = as.Date(
      mdy_hms(collection_date, quiet = TRUE)
    ),
    matrix,
    species = scientific_name,
    method,
    analyte = parameter,
    concentration_raw = value,
    concentration = parse_double(value),
    qualifier = na_if(str_trim(qualifier), ""),
    unit_original = unit
  ) |>
  mutate(
    collection_year = year(collection_date),
    detection_status = case_when(
      str_to_lower(qualifier) == "not detected" ~
        "non_detect",
      str_to_lower(qualifier) == "below the mdl" ~
        "below_mdl",
      is.na(qualifier) ~
        "unqualified",
      TRUE ~ "other_qualified"
    ),
    concentration_for_analysis = if_else(
      detection_status %in%
        c("non_detect", "below_mdl", "other_qualified"),
      NA_real_,
      concentration
    )
  ) |>
  relocate(collection_year, .after = collection_date)

# Export as a standard CSV
write_csv(noaa_clean, file.path(working_dir,"noaa_cleaned1986-2012.csv"), na = "")

```

)

write_csv(

  )
)

# Sampling site identifiers
```{r}
#install.packages("writexl")
library("writexl")

working_dir <- "../data/working"

# A. Identify distinct combinations of station and coordinates
noaa_locations <- noaa_clean |>
  transmute(
    source,
    study,
    site_id,
    site_name,
    latitude,
    longitude
  ) |>
  distinct() |>
  arrange(study, site_id, site_name)

# B. Audit variations within each source-study-site ID
site_audit <- noaa_locations |>
  group_by(source, study, site_id) |>
  summarise(
    n_site_names = n_distinct(site_name, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_coordinate_pairs = n_distinct(
      paste(latitude, longitude),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    n_missing_coordinates = sum(
      is.na(latitude) | is.na(longitude)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    review_status = case_when(
      is.na(site_id) | site_id == "" ~
        "Missing site ID",
      n_missing_coordinates > 0 ~
        "Review missing coordinates",
      n_site_names > 1 | n_coordinate_pairs > 1 ~
        "Review site variation",
      TRUE ~ "Unique site definition"
    )
  )

# C. Produce one row per source-study-site ID.
# Coordinates are retained only when the site has one
# unique non-missing coordinate pair.
noaa_identifiers <- noaa_locations |>
  left_join(
    site_audit,
    by = c("source", "study", "site_id")
  ) |>
  group_by(source, study, site_id) |>
  summarise(
    site_name = if (n_distinct(site_name,
                              na.rm = TRUE) == 1) {
      first(na.omit(site_name))
    } else {
      NA_character_
    },
    latitude = if (
      first(n_coordinate_pairs) == 1 &&
      first(n_missing_coordinates) == 0
    ) first(latitude) else NA_real_,
    longitude = if (
      first(n_coordinate_pairs) == 1 &&
      first(n_missing_coordinates) == 0
    ) first(longitude) else NA_real_,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(study, site_id)

# D. Retain all requested fields in the CSV
write_csv(
  noaa_identifiers,
  file.path(working_dir, "noaa_site_identifiers.csv")
)

# E. Create a station crosswalk template
crosswalk <- noaa_identifiers |>
  left_join(
    site_audit,
    by = c("source", "study", "site_id")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    matched_agency = NA_character_,
    matched_site_id = NA_character_,
    matched_site_name = NA_character_,
    match_type = NA_character_,
    match_status = "Not reviewed",
    reviewer = NA_character_,
    review_notes = NA_character_
  )

# F. Export a workbook with supporting audit sheets
write_xlsx(
  list(
    NOAA_Identifiers = noaa_identifiers,
    Crosswalk_Review = crosswalk,
    Coordinate_Variants = noaa_locations,
    Identifier_Audit = site_audit
  ),
  path = file.path(
    working_dir,
    "noaa_station_crosswalk.xlsx"
  )
)

# G. Confirm outputs
cat("Unique NOAA station IDs:", nrow(noaa_identifiers), "\n")
cat(
  "Stations requiring review:",
  sum(site_audit$review_status != "Unique site definition"),
  "\n"
)


```
